title: Configure the relay connection
responsibility: Create the remote-host runtime only when its origin and object binding are usable.

inputs.name: hubRemote.env
inputs.description: Environment containing relay origin, optional environment name and remote-host object binding.

outputs.name: hubRemote
outputs.description: Normalized origin and relay-management adapter, or null. Accepts exact HTTPS origins, plus HTTP localhost or 127.0.0.1 outside production; binding must expose idFromName and get functions.
